title: Postdoctoral Position in Software Engineering: Program Analysis and Repository Mining
description:
A 2-year postdoctoral researcher position is available at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in the Software Engineering section of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI). The successful candidate will contribute to the VILLUM Experiment project “Is Correctness Necessary? An Experiment in Test-Free Program Repair.” The project investigates whether software bugs can be repaired using information found in the code itself, without relying on test suites or specifications. The position is available from February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Project Description

Generating code is becoming cheap; establishing whether it is correct is not. Large language models can now produce and modify software at remarkable speed, and practices such as “vibe coding” are widening the gap between code generation and validation. Requiring a carefully designed test suite or specification for every generated fragment is unlikely to scale. Yet most automated repair techniques depend on exactly such a correctness oracle: without a failing test or specification, they have neither a clear repair target nor a way to assess a proposed change.

This project challenges that dependency by investigating whether software bugs can be repaired using evidence already present in the code. It will combine program analysis with patterns mined from existing software to explore whether multiple, independent sources of evidence can guide repair when tests or specifications are unavailable. The approach will be studied across different programming languages and evaluated on both real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants. The broader aim is to determine when code contains enough information to support its own repair and when knowledge of the intended behavior remains essential.

 

What we offer 

We offer a dynamic and supportive research environment within an internationally recognized institute. You will join an open, collaborative team that values teamwork, professional diligence, and innovation. The Software Engineering section provides flexible work conditions and strong support for individual development, including mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and responsibilities.

As part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, our section is involved in a variety of national and European research projects and enjoys a robust network of academic and industrial partners. This position provides an opportunity to engage with these collaborations and work on real-world challenges. We encourage and support our postdocs to publish their research in renowned journals and conferences, and to engage in knowledge exchange with colleagues and external research and industrial partners. The working language is English, and we pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive, and inspiring workplace that fosters personal and professional growth.

 

What we expect 

The appointed researcher will investigate whether software defects can be repaired without relying on test suites or specifications. The candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of a framework that combines program analysis with patterns mined from existing software. The work will involve experiments with real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants across multiple programming languages. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate who meets the following qualifications and characteristics:

  • A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Programming Languages, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

  • Research experience or a strong interest in one or more of the following areas: program analysis, mining software repositories, automated software engineering, software testing, or software repair.

  • An interest in software reliability challenges arising from AI-generated and AI-modified code.

  • Experience with empirical evaluation, software repositories, or bug benchmarks is an advantage.

  • Experience with one or more of C, Java, and Python is an advantage.

  • Proficiency in written and spoken English, with good communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team.

  • A strong research record or demonstrated research potential through publications or other relevant research outputs.

 

Workplace description 

The postdoc will be employed in the Software Engineering section at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), SDU. MMMI is an internationally recognized research institute within the Faculty of Engineering, known for its contributions to software engineering, robotics, and artificial intelligence. The Software Engineering section encompasses a range of research areas in software development, data analytics, and intelligent systems, and it plays a key role in several ongoing European projects.

Our workplace is truly international and collaborative. Researchers in the section come from diverse backgrounds and work closely together on cross-disciplinary projects. We benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and a strong administrative and technical support structure. The institute maintains close collaboration with other departments and centers at SDU, as well as with industry partners, providing a vibrant environment where theoretical research meets practical application. The position will be located on SDU’s Odense campus, which offers an attractive setting and a rich campus life in the city of Odense, Denmark’s hub for robotics and technology development.

 

Further information 

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Abhishek Tiwari (abti@mmmi.sdu.dk) or Assistant Professor Jyoti Prakash (jyp@mmmi.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from February 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

title: Sygeplejerske (klinisk vejleder) til neurologisk sengeafsnit, Neurologi, Fysio- og Ergoterapi, Regionshospitalet Gødstrup
description:
Drømmer du om at lære fra dig? Så har du chancen hér!

Du bliver klinisk vejleder i cirka halvdelen af din arbejdstid og resten af tiden sygeplejerske i neurologisk sengeafdeling. 

 

I klinisk vejledning vil du indgå i makkerskab med en anden sygeplejerske, som du deler ansvaret med. 

Vi arbejder aktuelt med læringszone, hvor vores vision er at skabe et særligt læringsmiljø for elever, studerende og nyansatte i afdelingen på tværs af fag. Du vil blive en central del af dette arbejde, som foregår i tæt samarbejde med andre faggruppers vejledningsansvarlige samt vores intro/oplæringsansvarlige sygeplejerske og andre med uddannelses/udviklingsansvar.

Hvis du ikke allerede har vejlederuddannelsen, tilbyder vi den. 

 

I den øvrige arbejdstid vil du høste værdifuld viden om neurologien, som er et varieret speciale med både korte, akutte forløb og lidt længere indlæggelser. 
Vi har brug for dig, som har et stort sygeplejerskehjerte og pædagogiske ambitioner - så skal vi nok hjælpe på vej i forhold til selve specialet.


Se stillings- og funktionsbeskrivelse for Klinisk vejleder her og Sygeplejerske her

 

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt netværk:

Vi har en tværfaglig tilgang med mange dygtige faggrupper, som understøtter en fælles løsning af opgaven med udgangspunkt i patientens behov. Vi bidrager med hver vores monofaglighed til god opgaveløsning, og vi lærer undervejs meget af hinanden. Se videopræsentation af vores afdeling her


Vi har stor diversitet i personalegruppen - både i forhold til alder, erfaring og kulturel baggrund, hvilket giver positive bidrag ind i et rigtig godt kollegialt samarbejde. Vi har et godt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor og gerne et socialt arrangement i ny og næ.

Vi arbejder aktivt med work-life balance under hensyntagen til både fællesskabet og kerneopgaven – fx. med forskellig vagtlængde.

 

Vi har som mål, at man skal glæde sig til at komme på arbejde – og være glad, når man går hjem igen.
Vores introduktion tilrettelægges ud fra dine ønsker og behov, og den kan indebære:

  • Opstart uden for normeringen.
  • Mentorordning over minimum ½ år
  • Løbende sidemandsoplæring.
  • Undervisning omkring afdelingens diagnoser og særlige opgaver.
  • Opmærksomhed på, at ikke alle skal lære på samme måde.

 

Der er tale om fastansættelse på fuld tid i blandede vagter. 
Du skal forvente vagt cirka hver 3. weekend.

Vil du gerne lige høre lidt mere? Vil du gerne se afdelingen først? 
Så kontakt gerne: 

  • Oversygeplejerske Jytte Borg Madsen på 30577286
  • Oversygeplejerske Lone Kristensen på 20137134.
     

Ansættelsen er betinget af tilfredsstillende børneattest og autorisation.

IT-kompetencer på brugerniveau forventes.

Du kan søge jobbet online ved at klikke på ”send ansøgning”. Vedhæft din ansøgning og dit CV.

Ansøgning kan fremsendes frem til 25. oktober 2026.  

Samtaler forventes afholdt den 28. oktober. 

Opstart 1. december 2026.

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Kreativ og fagligt stærk kantinemedarbejder i rollen som stedfortræder
description:
Vi søger en kantinemedarbejder til kantinen på Campus Holbæk, der brænder for arbejdet i en kantine. Vi søger dig, der har lyst til at være en del af et udviklende, solidarisk og omsorgsfuldt arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejdergruppen lægger vægt på trivsel og samhørighed.

På Professionshøjskolen Absalon har vi et ønske om at have levende campusmiljøer og sætte vores studerende i centrum. Dette kommer især til udtryk i vores kantiner, hvor vores studerende hver dag har mulighed for at købe et sundt og velsmagende måltid mad. Vi er løbende i dialog med de studerende rundt om buffeten i kantinen. Dette gør vi for at sikre, at de måltider, som vi serverer for de studerende, falder i deres smag og giver dem lyst til at samles i vores kantinemiljøer.

Din profil
Du skal som stedfortræder i kantinen være fagligt stærk og bidrage med ny inspiration i en travl hverdag, blandt andet i forhold til produktudvikling, smag og sanser. Derudover skal du have lyst til at være i et miljø med mange studerende, og du skal kunne træde ind og fungere i en koordinerende rolle, når kantinelederen ikke er til stede. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende profil:

Bæredygtigt fokus. Du har erfaring med at være i en kantine, hvor der er fokus på økologi, bæredygtighed og reduktion af madspild. Dit engagement for bæredygtighed i køkkenet kommer blandt andet til udtryk ved, at du har lyst og evne til at dele dine gode ideer og samtidig suger til dig, når du selv har mulighed for at opnå ny viden.

Overblik og omstillingsparat. I en hverdag med mange opgaver, der skal planlægges og følges op på, kan du træffe kvalificerede beslutninger, omsætte dem til handling og samtidig bevare overblikket. Du går struktureret til dine opgaver og løser dem med præcision og omhyggelighed. Du er ansvarsbevidst, serviceminded og engageret, både i forhold til opgaver og samarbejde. Blæser forandringens vinde, går du gerne forrest med en positiv tilgang.

Gode samarbejdsevner. Du evner at arbejde sammen med mange forskellige mennesker på tværs af faggrupper. Du har også evnen og lysten til en hverdag, der rummer det brede arbejdsmarked, hvilket f.eks. omfatter kolleger, der er ansat i virksomhedspraktik.

Erfaring med LEAN. Du har erfaring med LEAN som arbejdsredskab, og du har med egne øjne set eksempler på, hvordan det ved hjælp af LEAN er muligt at frigive tid og ressourcer til andre vigtige gøremål i en travl hverdag.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:
  • taler og skriver dansk og engelsk
  • har kendskab til Office-pakken på brugerniveau
  • har erfaring fra lignende stillinger i en kantine eller køkken.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som kantinemedarbejder kommer du til at arbejde med følgende opgaver:

Udvikling i dagligdagen. I en travl hverdag får du en vigtig rolle, når vi skal udvikle arbejdsgange eller finde på nye spændende måder at anvende appelsinskræller eller broccolistokke på i forsøget på at opnå et endnu mere bæredygtigt fokus.

Deltage i kantinens drift. Du skal være med til at producere kolde og varme retter såvel som brød, kager og meget andet, som vi sælger i kantinen. Du skal også være med til at planlægge menuen og bestille varer hjem, samt være med til at modtage varerne, når disse leveres. Derudover skal du i løbet af en dag ekspedere i kantinens salgsområde og foretage egenkontrol.

Sørge for kursister og gæster. På vores campus har vi en del kurser og konferencer for interne såvel som eksterne virksomheder og organisationer. Du har i forbindelse med kurser og konferencer en vigtig rolle i forhold til, at kursister og gæster får den rette forplejning på det rigtige tidspunkt, så de føler, at servicen er i top.

Stedfortræder for leder. Du skal drive køkkenet i samarbejde med dine kolleger og bevare overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften. Som stedfortræder forventes det, at du kan bestille varer, sikre en velfungerende kantinedrift og træffe beslutninger på lederens vegne, når det er nødvendigt.

Dine kolleger
Kantinen på Campus Holbæk er et team bestående af en ansvarlig kok/kantinemedarbejder og en kantinemedarbejder. Du refererer til vores kantineleder på Campus Kalundborg, hvor der også kan forekomme vagter. Hos os går vi op i kvalitet, at der er en uformel omgangstone, og at det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Alle campusser i Absalon har tilknyttet en eller flere kantiner, hvor studerende og ansatte hver dag har mulighed for at købe et sundt og velsmagende måltid. Dine kolleger har et stort fokus på, at deres arbejde ikke kun er madproduktion og salg - kantinen er det uformelle samlingspunkt på campus og altid et rart sted at være. Vi arbejder i teams, og selvom vi er spredt på forskellige campusser, samarbejder vi på tværs og går op i at skabe holdånd og fællesskab, uanset om du arbejder i Holbæk, Slagelse, Vordingborg eller på en af de øvrige campusser.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Afhængigt af din uddannelsesbaggrund og anciennitet vil en forventet løn ligge mellem 29.000 kr. og 32.000 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 15%, 16% eller 18,4% afhængigt af din uddannelsesbaggrund. Din løn bliver sammensat af basisløn, funktionstillæg og evt. kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have, at du begynder den 1. december 2026 eller snarest derefter.
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte kantineleder Søren Loui Frydensberg, der kan træffes dagligt fra kl. 13.00 - 15.00 på tlf.: 7248 2253 eller mail skre@pha.dk.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 19. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. ansættelsessamtale den 23. oktober 2026 og 2. ansættelsessamtale den 26. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

Teamleder til kørselsafdeling

Teamleder til kørselsafdelingen - skab struktur, fremdrift og stærke leverancer

Har du blik for både mennesker, logistik og den gode drift?

Trives du med at skabe struktur i en hverdag, hvor planer kan ændre sig hurtigt- og motiveres du af at få medarbejdere, biler og leverancer til at spille sammen?

Hos Idealcombi søger vi nu en handlekraftig og struktureret teamleder til vores kørselsafdeling, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige ledelse og sikre en effektiv kørselsplanlægning til vores kunder i Danmark og på eksportmarkederne.

Om stillingen

Som teamleder får du det daglige ansvar for kørselsafdelingen og vores chauffører. Du bliver en central del af den daglige drift og får ansvaret for at sikre, at vores leverancer planlægges og gennemføres effektivt, og at kunderne får den rette information undervejs.

Du er tæt på medarbejderne og den operationelle hverdag og skal kunne bevare overblikket, prioritere og træffe beslutninger, når virkeligheden ændrer sig. Samtidig får du en lederopgave, hvor du gennem løbende dialog, opfølgning og udvikling sikrer et velfungerende og motiveret team.

Kørselsafdelingen har en stor kontaktflade på tværs af Idealcombi, og du kommer særligt til at samarbejde med produktion, salg og øvrige interne funktioner. Derfor er det afgørende, at du kommunikerer tydeligt og formår at skabe gode samarbejdsrelationer, både internt og eksternt.

Dine primære ansvarsområder vil blandt andet være:
  • Planlægning og koordinering af kørsel for både Danmark og eksport
  • Sikre leveringsadvisering til kunder og opfølgning på restordrer
  • Daglig ledelse og udvikling af medarbejderne i kørselsafdelingen og vores chauffører
  • Sikre god koordinering og kommunikation med kunder, chauffører og interne samarbejdspartnere

Du bliver også ansvarlig for, at vores ledelsessystem og relevante personalepolitikker efterleves i afdelingen, og at teamet løbende har de rette kompetencer til at løse opgaverne.

Din profil

Du er en synlig leder, der trives tæt på driften og medarbejderne. Du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og har gennemslagskraft, når der skal prioriteres og træffes beslutninger.

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis have mange års formel ledererfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har forståelse for transport, logistik eller kørselsplanlægning og samtidig har lysten og evnen til at tage ansvar for både mennesker og drift.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har erfaring med kørselsplanlægning, transport, logistik eller disponering
  • Gerne har en relevant baggrund som fx kørselsdisponent, speditør eller lignende
  • Har ledererfaring, eller er klar til at tage næste skridt ind i en lederrolle
  • Arbejder systematisk og struktureret og er stærk i din opfølgning
  • Har gennemslagskraft og bevarer overblikket i en travl og omskiftelig hverdag
  • Er god til at kommunikere og skabe relationer på tværs af organisationen
  • Har erfaring med ERP-systemer og er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer
  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk i skrift og tale

Vi tilbyder

Hos Idealcombi får du en central rolle i en funktion, der har stor betydning for både vores kunder og den daglige drift.

Du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på kørselsafdelingen og være med til løbende at udvikle både medarbejdere, arbejdsgange og samarbejdet på tværs af virksomheden.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:
  • En selvstændig lederrolle med ansvar og mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel
  • En varieret hverdag, hvor drift, ledelse, planlægning og problemløsning går hånd i hånd
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde og ordentlighed vægtes højt
  • En lønpakke, der matcher dine kvalifikationer, inkl. pension og sundhedsordning

Kontakt og ansøgning

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabrikschef Allan Sørensen på tlf. 96 88 24 85 eller mail als@idealcombi.dk.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV snarest muligt. Ansøgninger behandles løbende og fortroligt, og vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 08-11-2026.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Om Idealcombi

Idealcombi har, siden det første vindue blev fremstillet i 1973, haft domicil i Thy. Hovedsædet i Hurup rummer i dag 100.000 m² til produktion og administration med mere end 400 ansatte.

Herfra har Idealcombi gennem mere end 50 år fremstillet vinduer og yderdøre i høj kvalitet. Innovation er et grundlæggende omdrejningspunkt i virksomheden, og vi arbejder kontinuerligt og målrettet på at være blandt de førende inden for udviklingen af vinduer og døre til nutidens og fremtidens behov.

Design, funktion, energiforbrug og en optimal miljøvenlig produktion er blandt de væsentligste parametre - og vores medarbejderes kompetencer er afgørende for, at vi lykkes.

title: FAÇADE DECORATOR / STUCCO WORKER / SPECIALIST MASON
description:
Are you an experienced craftsman with a passion for traditional craftsmanship and decorative work?

We are a Danish construction company specialising in high-end properties, historic and listed buildings, and projects that require a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail.

We are looking for an experienced façade decorator, stucco worker or specialist mason with proven experience in decorative façade work and traditional building techniques.

The ideal candidate will have several years of experience working with cornices, mouldings, ornaments, decorative façades, stucco and detailed plasterwork, and will know how to recreate and restore decorative features with the precision and quality required when working on historic and architecturally significant buildings.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional bricklayer. What is most important to us is that you are highly skilled in your craft and have genuine experience with decorative and ornamental work carried out using traditional methods.

We are looking for someone who:

● Has solid and documented experience in façade decoration, stucco work or specialist masonry

● Has experience working on historic, older or listed buildings

● Is experienced in traditional techniques and materials

● Has a strong eye for detail, proportions and high-quality finishes

● Is able to work independently and take responsibility for the quality of their work

● Understands and respects the original architecture of historic buildings

● Can provide professional references and preferably photographs of previous projects

What we offer

You will become part of a professional team working on exclusive and unique properties and projects where traditional craftsmanship and attention to detail are highly valued.

You will have the opportunity to work on challenging and interesting projects where your experience and specialist skills are genuinely appreciated.

Salary will be negotiated according to qualifications and experience.

If you have the experience, craftsmanship and passion for the details that make a difference, we would be very interested in hearing from you.

Please send us a short application, CV and, if possible, photographs and references from previous work.

We look forward to hearing from you and discussing the possibility of you joining our team.

title: Global Mental Health Researcher
description:
DIGNITY is looking for a Global Mental Health Researcher to join our International Programmes Department. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated, early-career researcher, who wants to generate new and impactful knowledge, strengthen mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) programming, and contribute to better outcomes for people affected by torture and other forms of violence and adversity.

DIGNITY is an international human rights and development organization with a significant research capacity that works to prevent torture and violence, rehabilitate survivors, and enable justice and accountability. Our International Programmes Department works closely with local civil society partners, researchers and public institutions in countries affected by conflict, violence and political repression. Research plays a central role in our work by fostering innovation and critical reflection and generating evidence that strengthens programmes, informs policy and contributes to improved practice and impact.

About the position

As Global Mental Health Researcher, you will join our newly established International Research and Learning Unit together with an interdisciplinary team of senior researchers and monitoring and evaluation experts and analysts. Your tasks will be i) to contribute to developing DIGNITY’s international research agenda on Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) and ii) to offer technical advice to our rehabilitation programmes. You will be working with DIGNITY’s senior researchers, project managers and technical experts and collaborate closely with our partners in Asia, Africa, MENA and Eastern Europe. As an early-career researcher, we expect you to take on and develop the following tasks and responsibilities with a strong commitment to learn and grow as a researcher and advisor at DIGNITY.

Primary responsibilities
  1. To develop and conduct MHPSS research with guidance from DIGNITY Senior Researchers
  2. To support ongoing research in collaboration with DIGNITY’s Senior Researchers
  3. To offer advise on development and evaluation of DIGNITY’s MHPSS projects and programming in low- and middle-income countries

Specific tasks include:

  • To develop and conduct research projects and contribute to the formulation of grant applications focused on mental health and well-being of populations affected by violence and other forms of adversity, in line with DIGNITY’s strategy and mandate
  • To support ongoing research through qualitative and quantitative data analysis, coauthoring manuscripts and reports, and collaboration on grant applications
  • To contribute to the strengthening of DIGNITY’s MHPSS research agenda, networks and profile
  • To produce peer reviewed publications and other impactful research outputs
  • To provide technical advising for MHPSS projects
  • To contribute to the capacity building to partners and public authorities in DIGNITY programme contexts
  • To provide programmatic input to project documents, funding applications, policy and advocacy
About you

You hold a PhD in Psychology, Public Health or another relevant interdisciplinary field.

In addition, we expect that you have:

  • Competencies and experiences in applied research
  • Abilities and interest in to translating technical expertise into actionable knowledge for non-experts
  • Familiarity with evidence-based manualized MHPSS(e.g. PM+)
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative research methods
  • Basic understanding of project management methodologies and tools
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities, tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Good collaboration and communication skills and strong commitments to work in teams and to co-produce knowledge and learning
  • Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment
  • Experiences with and/or strong interests in trauma-informed approaches to vulnerable and at-risk populations
  • Experiences with and/or strong interests in intersectional, decolonial, rights-based and/or survivor-centred approaches an advantage
  • Proficiency in Arabic, French, Ukrainian or Russian is an advantage
We offer
  • A meaningful research position in an internationally recognised human rights and development organisation.
  • An opportunity to contribute to globally relevant research that improves the lives of torture survivors and other populations affected by violence.
  • A collaborative and highly professional international research environment.
  • Close collaboration with experienced researchers, programme colleagues and local partners across multiple countries.
  • Flexible working arrangements and a strong emphasis on work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, learning and professional development.
Terms of employment

The position is permanent and based in DIGNITY’s International Programmes Department in the International Research and Learning Unit with reference to the Head of International Research and Learning.

Your place of employment is Copenhagen at our HQ at Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

We expect you to have a civil registry address in Denmark during the full employment.

Expected entry is 1 February 2027.

Your working hours are 37 hours per week, with the expectation that additional work may take place. It will be possible to take time off after having additional working hours within our flexible work schedule.

The position includes approximately 40 days of international travel annually.

Salary and terms of employment will follow the applicable Danish collective agreement and will be based on qualifications and relevant experience. The salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 42.-47.000 (gross, monthly) + pension (18.07%).

More info

Further information regarding the position can be obtained by contacting Head of International Research and Learning Tomas Max Martin at tm@dignity.dk.

The position will be filled following an academic assessment. As part of the hiring process, the shortlisted candidates’ research qualifications will be assessed with focus on research publications, grants, academic paper presentations, convening of panels, academic networks, research dissemination and communication, real-world and policy impact.

An application consisting of:

  • A CV
  • a motivational letter
  • documentation of completed PhD degree
  • a complete publication list
  • three selected peer reviewed articles (for co-authored publications, applicants should briefly describe their own contribution to each of the three selected publications), and
  • a short academic portfolio (maximum three pages) describing the applicant's contribution to selected research projects and publications, methodological expertise, experience with research funding, international research collaboration and networks, research dissemination, teaching experience and examples of contributions to policy, practice or programming (with links to documents where appropriate).

should be submitted via the link no later than 25 October 2026.

Shortlisted candidates will be assessed in the first half of November, and all applicants will be notified whether their application has been accepted for assessment.

We expect to hold the first round of interviews in November 2026 (week 48) and the second round of interviews end of November/start December 2026 (week 49), and both will take place in Copenhagen.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: Privacy policy - DIGNITY - Danish Institute Against Torture.

DIGNITY is an international human rights and development organisation that has worked for a world free of torture and violence since 1982. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be prosecuted. You can read more about our organisation and work at www.dignity.dk. DIGNITY regards diversity as a strength and therefore encourages all qualified persons to apply for the position regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age.

title: Postdoctoral Position in Software Engineering: Program Analysis and Repository Mining
description:
A 2-year postdoctoral researcher position is available at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in the Software Engineering section of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI). The successful candidate will contribute to the VILLUM Experiment project “Is Correctness Necessary? An Experiment in Test-Free Program Repair.” The project investigates whether software bugs can be repaired using information found in the code itself, without relying on test suites or specifications. The position is available from February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Project Description

Generating code is becoming cheap; establishing whether it is correct is not. Large language models can now produce and modify software at remarkable speed, and practices such as “vibe coding” are widening the gap between code generation and validation. Requiring a carefully designed test suite or specification for every generated fragment is unlikely to scale. Yet most automated repair techniques depend on exactly such a correctness oracle: without a failing test or specification, they have neither a clear repair target nor a way to assess a proposed change.

This project challenges that dependency by investigating whether software bugs can be repaired using evidence already present in the code. It will combine program analysis with patterns mined from existing software to explore whether multiple, independent sources of evidence can guide repair when tests or specifications are unavailable. The approach will be studied across different programming languages and evaluated on both real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants. The broader aim is to determine when code contains enough information to support its own repair and when knowledge of the intended behavior remains essential.

 

What we offer 

We offer a dynamic and supportive research environment within an internationally recognized institute. You will join an open, collaborative team that values teamwork, professional diligence, and innovation. The Software Engineering section provides flexible work conditions and strong support for individual development, including mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and responsibilities.

As part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, our section is involved in a variety of national and European research projects and enjoys a robust network of academic and industrial partners. This position provides an opportunity to engage with these collaborations and work on real-world challenges. We encourage and support our postdocs to publish their research in renowned journals and conferences, and to engage in knowledge exchange with colleagues and external research and industrial partners. The working language is English, and we pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive, and inspiring workplace that fosters personal and professional growth.

 

What we expect 

The appointed researcher will investigate whether software defects can be repaired without relying on test suites or specifications. The candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of a framework that combines program analysis with patterns mined from existing software. The work will involve experiments with real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants across multiple programming languages. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate who meets the following qualifications and characteristics:

  • A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Programming Languages, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

  • Research experience or a strong interest in one or more of the following areas: program analysis, mining software repositories, automated software engineering, software testing, or software repair.

  • An interest in software reliability challenges arising from AI-generated and AI-modified code.

  • Experience with empirical evaluation, software repositories, or bug benchmarks is an advantage.

  • Experience with one or more of C, Java, and Python is an advantage.

  • Proficiency in written and spoken English, with good communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team.

  • A strong research record or demonstrated research potential through publications or other relevant research outputs.

 

Workplace description 

The postdoc will be employed in the Software Engineering section at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), SDU. MMMI is an internationally recognized research institute within the Faculty of Engineering, known for its contributions to software engineering, robotics, and artificial intelligence. The Software Engineering section encompasses a range of research areas in software development, data analytics, and intelligent systems, and it plays a key role in several ongoing European projects.

Our workplace is truly international and collaborative. Researchers in the section come from diverse backgrounds and work closely together on cross-disciplinary projects. We benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and a strong administrative and technical support structure. The institute maintains close collaboration with other departments and centers at SDU, as well as with industry partners, providing a vibrant environment where theoretical research meets practical application. The position will be located on SDU’s Odense campus, which offers an attractive setting and a rich campus life in the city of Odense, Denmark’s hub for robotics and technology development.

 

Further information 

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Abhishek Tiwari (abti@mmmi.sdu.dk) or Assistant Professor Jyoti Prakash (jyp@mmmi.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from February 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

title: HSEQ Manager - Balance of Plant; Location: DK - Esbjerg, UK - Grimsby

Are you an experienced HSEQ professional with a passion for renewable energy and safe project delivery? Do you want to help shape safe, compliant and efficient Balance of Plant projects? Join us and become an energy pioneer in the industry!

Your position

In your new position as HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be a key member of our Renewables HSEQ function, supporting safe and compliant Balance of Plant project delivery across offshore wind projects. You will provide first-line HSEQ leadership, guide and support HSEQ Advisors, and work closely with Project Managers, the Head of BoP and operational teams to ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded from tender and pre-project preparation through to execution, reporting and lessons learned.

We are not just looking for someone who is technically qualified and experienced; we are looking for someone who shares our view of safety.

As part of the recruitment process, we will discuss how you see New View safety concepts, including Safety I and Safety II, HOP, and Safety Differently, working together to deliver safe outcomes. We will also explore how you believe the right information can be provided to the right people, whether that is controls for frontline workers, data for support teams, or due diligence information for leadership teams. In addition, we will discuss your perspective on the role of the HSEQ team in enabling learning, supporting operations and strengthening safe delivery.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be responsible for supporting safe, compliant and efficient project delivery from sales and pre-project kick-off preparation through to project execution, operational learning, customer support and knowledge sharing.

  • Preparing and managing project-specific HSEQ documentation, including Project HSEQ Plans, Construction Phase Plans, emergency response plans, bridging documents, RAMS, LOTO input and supporting reference documents.

  • Supporting sales, tenders and project planning by reviewing contracts, identifying HSEQ deliverables and ensuring adequate costs and resources are planned for required HSEQ activities.

  • Preparing and contributing to kick-off meetings, project meetings and HSEQ presentations, ensuring relevant safety rules, evacuation arrangements, reporting requirements, initiatives, safety alerts and lessons learned are communicated.

  • Monitoring project execution, including completion of emergency response drill plans, weather day training plans, site visit quality, Synergy use, EFA kit compliance, action follow-up and investigation quality.

  • Leading or supporting significant investigations, ensuring clear descriptions, root causes, contributing factors, control measures and corrective and preventative actions are identified, tracked and closed effectively.

  • Maintaining professional relationships with client representatives, supporting positive safety culture, encouraging reporting and learning, and facilitating end-of-project lessons learned.



Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured, proactive and collaborative HSEQ professional who is passionate about offshore renewable energy and wants to leave their mark on safe project execution. You take ownership of HSEQ standards, are confident engaging with operational and project stakeholders, and can balance operational essentials with learning-focused activities that improve safety outcomes.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • Solid HSEQ experience within offshore wind, marine, construction, renewables or other project-based operational environments.

  • Experience preparing, reviewing and maintaining HSEQ documentation such as RAMS, HSEQ plans, emergency response plans, drill plans, investigation reports and lessons learned material.

  • Confidence supporting tenders, contract reviews, project kick-off activities and HSEQ input to operational planning.

  • Experience guiding, supporting or leading HSEQ Advisors or site-based HSEQ personnel.

  • Strong investigation, reporting and follow-up skills, with the ability to identify trends, communicate areas of concern and drive actions through to completion.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work closely with Project Managers, clients, offshore teams and senior HSEQ leadership.



Welcome to Semco Maritime

With us, you will be part of a community of over 2,000 dedicated people who are driving change and making a real difference in meeting the world's growing energy demand.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Biomason’s production facility in Ikast.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is motivated by solving real technical challenges, improving operational and equipment reliability, and helping scale a first-of-a-kind process toward commercial production.

Do you have solid experience from an industrial or manufacturing environment, and do you thrive in a setting where not everything has been fully built or established yet? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

Read more about the role in the below job description.

If you have technical questions, you are welcome to contact Director of Plant Performance Aaron Bellis at +45 28966291 or HR Partner René Bitsch at +45 21756113.

If you are from a recruitment agency please note that we will contact you if we need your assistance.

Job description

The position:

As Mechanical engineer, you will play a hands-on role in establishing, stabilizing, and improving the mechanical performance of our first-of-a-kind tile production facility in Ikast. This role will work closely together with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Process Engineering to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant performance. You will help translate innovative process science into robust day-to-day manufacturing at the first of a kind facility, while driving structured problem-solving, equipment reliability, ppm, plant expansion support, and continuous improvement across the facility.

You will support the scaling of this process to our first commercial facility from engineering design and equipment selection through commissioning, start-up, and operations working together with our project department and our EPC firms.

Responsibilities also include:

  • Mechanical Operations & Equipment Reliability

    • Provide day-to-day supervisory and execution support for electrical and mechanical systems and production equipment across the tile manufacturing process.

    • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for mechanical failures, downtime events, and recurring equipment issues.

    • Help establish preventive and predictive maintenance routines for critical equipment, utilities, and production assets.

    • Support commissioning, start-up, and scale-up activities in a FOAK environment, helping to translate development work into reliable plant operation.

  • Production Support & Continuous Improvement

    • Partner with Operations and Quality teams to improve equipment performance, uptime, process stability, and product consistency.

    • Contribute to waste reduction, line efficiency, and standardization efforts as production scales.

  •   Technical leadership

    • Support the development of SOPs, technical work instructions, equipment care standards, and troubleshooting guides.

  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams on equipment modifications, installation work, and performance improvements.

  • Project engineering and commercial facility scale-up

    • With the Director of projects and an EPC firm, act as Biomason’s lead mechanical engineer supporting the development of FEL3 and detailed engineering design packages including participation in and review of Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs), Heat and Material Balances (HMBs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), General Arrangements (GAs), Basis of Design (BoD) documents, equipment specification and selection, and HAZOP (Hazard an Operations study).

    • Support the commissioning and startup of the commercial facility through:

      • Participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at vendor sites as needed and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) at the facility.

      • Provide on-site technical leadership during the "boots-on-the-ground" commissioning phase, troubleshooting mechanical, thermal, or other deviations in real-time.

      • Bridge the gap between EPC firms and internal operations to ensure a seamless handover.

What we are looking for:

  • Experience

    • Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical engineering, maintenance engineering, or a similar industrial role.

    • Strong experience in industrial process or manufacturing environments, ideally with automated or semi-automated production equipment. Concrete manufacturing or other heavy industry is bonus but not essential.

    • Experience with motors, heat exchangers, airflow and hydraulics is a strong advantage.

    • Basic electrical experience testing logout tag out.

    • Experience supporting production start-ups, greenfield projects, FOAK environments, or first-time industrial implementation is strongly preferred.

  • Technical Expertise

    • Experience working with crane and conveyance systems is a critical requirement of this position

    • Strong understanding of industrial mechanical systems, equipment reliability, maintenance strategies, and structured troubleshooting.

    • Experience with 5S, good manufacturing practices, and continuous improvement in a production setting.

    • Ability to read technical drawings, manuals, equipment layouts, P&IDs, and supplier documentation.

    • Familiarity with Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing principles, root cause analysis methodologies, and continuous improvement practices is an advantage.

  • Management & Interpersonal Skills

    • High attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex, detail-oriented projects and ensure disciplined follow-up through execution.

    • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work across functions and cultures, preferable experience from a matrix organization..

    • Structured, practical, and data-informed approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

    • Contractor control

    • Fluency in English is essential

On a personal level, the role needs the following approach:

  • Proactive with a practical approach and the ability to be hands-on 

  • Motivation to solve real industrial challenges

  • Flexible where systems and routines are still being built

  • A collaborative mindset, but also the ability to solve matters on your own

  • Good safety attitude

  • Can do attitude

title: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark
description:
Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).
New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).
New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.
Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.
A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.
Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.
Value a strong professional network across hospitals.
Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.
Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.
Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.
On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).
About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.
Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.
