title: Master Thesis on Adaptive Distributed Control of Grid-Forming BESS
description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:

Background

    

The increasing penetration of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) has accelerated the transition toward sustainable transportation and resilient electrical grids. Modern BESS installations are evolving into modular systems composed of multiple battery systems and multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs). Current hierarchical control architectures enable coordinated operation, it also introduces communication dependency, latency and scalability challenges. This type of architecture relies on hierarchical communication between the Energy Management System (EMS), local BESS controllers and individual PCS controllers. Multiple communication layers may introduce delays, synchronization errors and reduced dynamic performance in the grid-forming operation. Communication failures or packet loss can degrade power sharing, frequency regulation and transient stability.

     Research Question  

The objective of this master thesis is to develop and validate an adaptive distributed control strategy for modular grid-forming Battery Energy Storage Systems comprising multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs) and multiple Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESSs). The proposed solution should reduce communication dependency, improve dynamic performance during power dispatch, enhance robustness against communication failures and delays, and provide a scalable control architecture suitable for future large-scale energy storage systems.







Objectives




    Reduce dependency on hierarchical communication.  
    Improve dynamic response during power dispatch.  
    Maintain accurate active/reactive power sharing.  
    Improve scalability for future modular BESS installations.  
    Develop and evaluate virtual impedance control to reduce circulating currents caused by   voltage, phase, and impedance mismatches among parallel PCSs.  

     Scope Of Work  


    Conduct a literature review on grid-forming converters, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control, hierarchical and distributed control architectures for modular BESSs. Review the limitations of hierarchical communication, the motivation for adaptive control under varying operating conditions, and the applicability of Model Predictive Control (MPC) for predictive power sharing and constraint handling. [Weeks 1-4]  
    Develop a hierarchical grid-forming control model for multiple parallel PCSs and BESSs, including communication-based power dispatch, power-sharing control, and virtual impedance control. This model will serve as the reference for performance comparison. [Weeks 5-12]  
    Design and implement a distributed adaptive control strategy that reduces dependence on hierarchical communication while maintaining stable grid-forming operation, accurate active/reactive power sharing, and robust performance under communication delays and failures. If appropriate, investigate MPC to improve predictive power dispatch and constraint management. [Weeks 13-21]  
    Validate the proposed control strategy in MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS and/or PSCAD under representative operating scenarios, including load variations, communication delays, communication failures, and grid disturbances. [Weeks 22-26]  
    Compare the proposed distributed control with the baseline hierarchical controller using performance metrics including active/reactive power-sharing accuracy, frequency and voltage deviations, settling time, circulating current, communication bandwidth, and overall system robustness. [Week 27-29]  

     Candidate Competencies  


    Two MS students with the solid backgrounds in electrical engineering, with basic knowledge of power electronics, control systems, and power systems  
    Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar simulation tools like PSCAD or DIgSILENT is desirable.  
    Knowledge or previous experience in grid-connected converter control, BESS/PCS systems, adaptive or distributed control, and power-system stability is considered a merit.  

     Ready for the next move?  

Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today!



Roeland BisschopHead of BESS Product Developmentroeland.bisschop@volvo.com

title: Vision Engineer
description:
Lyten is leading an industrial revolution through Lyten 3D Graphene™, a breakthrough supermaterial unlocking a new generation of products — from lithium–sulfur batteries and energy storage systems to concrete admixtures, lightweight composites, and next-generation sensors that are revolutionizing industries. Together, these innovations are making a massive global improvement and driving real-world impact across energy, mobility, construction, and defense.

At Lyten, we believe the most meaningful careers begin with purpose — and with people who want to make a difference. We’re not just developing advanced supermaterials — we’re about to change the world as we know it, reshaping how energy is stored, how products are built, and how progress is made.

We’re entering an exciting growth phase, scaling production across the U.S. and Europe and expanding our team of engineers, scientists, and innovators.

Apply now to join our team and be part of something bigger than yourself — where collaboration, creativity, and purpose come together to build the technologies that will define the next century.



Lyten is seeking a Vision Engineer with a specialization in vision systems for manufacturing equipment. As a Vision Engineer you will be responsible to develop, integrate, and improve vision systems for manufacturing equipment. You will work closely together with production, process, quality, and software engineers to compose algorithms to process massive amounts of manufacturing data for inline and offline processing. You will ensure vision systems integrated in manufacturing equipment meet availability, reliability, and resolve production issues.

Key Responsibilities

    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define vision system requirements, select suitable hardware and software, and create robust solutions for production lines.
    Install, configure, and calibrate vision systems, ensuring seamless integration with existing equipment and to Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
    Develop and execute comprehensive test plans to validate system performance, accuracy, and reliability under real-world manufacturing conditions.
    Analyze data from vision system metrics to identify opportunities for optimization and implement enhancements.  
    Provide ongoing support for deployed machine vision systems, calibration of vision cameras, and troubleshooting issues.
    Organize and take part in internal training and workshops.  
    Cost estimations for projects and change requests. Provide input for quoting, planning works, and change orders.



Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role

    Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Software Engineering, Electronics/Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
    Experience within Industrial Vision System applications in Battery Cell, Automotive, Semiconductors, Pharma etc.  

Qualifications and Experience

    Minimum 5 years of experience writing production-level C/C++, Python, or Go. Experience with real-time vision systems and generic programming are highly desirable.  
    Experience with computer vision projects, OpenCV library.
    Strong mathematical fundamentals including linear algebra, vector calculus, probability, and statics.
    Basic Git knowledge for creating and merging branches, cherry-picking commits, examining the difference between two hashes.



Specific skills & Knowledge  

    Expertise with leading vision systems (Cognex, Keyence, Teledyne, ISRA etc.)
    Understand rollout procedures to an automative-grade production line with procedures such as calibration and MSA.
    Familiarity with image processing, camera calibration and optical principles
    Understanding of communication protocols (Profinet, EtherCAT, TCP/IP etc.)
    Ability to work independently and as part of a team
    Familiarity with machine learning for vision applications
    Fluent in English, both verbal and written.

Why Work at Lyten

At Lyten, you’ll be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible in energy, materials, and manufacturing. We’re not just imagining the future — we’re building it today with breakthrough technologies that are changing how products are made and how industries innovate.

Our people are the heart of that mission. From world-class scientists and engineers to creative problem-solvers in operations, manufacturing, and commercialization, every member of the Lyten team plays a role in turning bold ideas into real-world impact. We believe that the best work happens when you’re doing great things in the world — with people you like. Collaboration, curiosity, and a shared sense of purpose drive everything we do.

What You’ll Find at Lyten

    A mission that matters: Contribute directly to solving complex challenges in energy, mobility, and materials innovation.
    

    Cutting-edge innovation: Work on technologies at the intersection of materials science, energy storage, and advanced manufacturing that strengthen energy security and local supply chains.
    

    Extraordinary people: Join a team of talented, friendly, and down-to-earth innovators who support, challenge, and inspire one another every day.
    

    Teamwork and culture: Experience a workplace built on trust, respect, and shared success — where collaboration fuels breakthroughs and everyone’s ideas are heard.
    

    Global impact: Help scale new materials and energy solutions that reinforce industrial resilience across the U.S. and Europe.
    Career growth: Be part of a fast-moving company entering a commercial growth phase, with opportunities to lead, learn, and make your mark.
    Purpose-driven values: Thrive in an environment that celebrates ingenuity, optimism, and meaningful progress — together.

Lyten offers the opportunity to do the most important work of your career — helping build the technologies that will power the next century of innovation.

Join us, and help transform industries, communities, and the planet with friends who share your drive to make a difference.

title: SCADA and Control Systems Engineer to a global company in Ludvika
description:
Our client is a global technology company within power transmission and electrification. The organization designs, builds, and upgrades high-voltage transmission installations that move electricity across regions and countries, and its technology is a key enabler of the ongoing energy transition. The site in Ludvika is one of the company's main engineering centres in Sweden, with a large international engineering community and a strong technical tradition.

About HVDC Service

The HVDC Service organisation works with upgrades, service and warranty support for HVDC installations already in operation around the world. Since these installations have a lifespan of around many years and are upgraded regularly, this is a long, ongoing pipeline of brownfield engineering work.  

About the role

We are looking for a SCADA and Control Systems Engineer to join our clients engineering organization supporting HVDC, substation automation and power system projects. In this role you will contribute to the design, implementation and integration of SCADA, control and monitoring systems used in critical power infrastructure.

We are looking for a profile with experience in SCADA systems, industrial communication networks and control system integration. Experience from power systems, STATCOM, utility environments, substations, renewable energy applications or industrial automation is highly valued.

Responsibilities

• Support engineering teams in the design, configuration and testing of SCADA and monitoring systems. • Provide technical guidance and coordinate activities within smaller engineering teams when required. • Configure and integrate control system components, RTUs and communication interfaces. • Participate in the development and implementation of HMI and visualization solutions. • Support customer discussions regarding control systems, monitoring solutions and industrial communications. • Perform testing, troubleshooting and commissioning activities. • Contribute to technical documentation, validation and system verification activities. • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout project execution.

Background

• Experience working with SCADA systems and industrial automation - a minimum of 4-5 years of experience in SCADA, industrial automation or power system control applications is required. • Experience with control systems, RTUs, data acquisition and monitoring solutions. • Knowledge of PLC/HMI applications and industrial control systems. • Understanding of industrial communication protocols such as IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, OPC UA, Profinet or Ethernet/IP. • Experience with system integration, communication networks and industrial infrastructure. • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or equivalent. • Fluent English is required. Swedish is considered an advantage.

Meritorious

• Experience from power utilities, substations, power generation, renewable energy or other critical infrastructure environments. • Experience with modern SCADA platforms and HMI development. • Experience with RTACs, gateways, protection and control systems or substation automation solutions. • Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity principles and secure communication architectures. • Experience with commissioning and field support activities. • Experience working in international project environments. • Willingness to learn Swedish and engage with the local working environment.

Other:

Location: Presence in Ludvika is mandatory.

Start date: According to agreement

Employment type: You will initially be employed by A-hub as a consultant, with the ambition of moving to direct employment with our client after 12 months

Security screening: Background and security checks will be conducted as part of the recruitment process. Some roles require Swedish citizenship.

A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy (https://www.a-hub.se/integritetspolicy).

title: Experienced Software Engineer  Java/.NET Platform
description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join the team responsible for developing the software platforms underlying COMSOL Multiphysics®. You will work with the runtimes, libraries, build systems, and platform integrations that form the foundation of a large, cross-platform engineering software product. The majority of the development is done in Java and C#, together with build and automation tooling.

About COMSOL

COMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.

Role

Based in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.

In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.

You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.

The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.

Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.

Qualifications

For this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:

    M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
    Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
    Several years of professional software development experience.
    An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:

    Large software projects and mature codebases.
    Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
    Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
    Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
    Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
    Build and development automation.
    Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.

Working at COMSOL

At COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.

New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.

We also offer:

    A competitive salary
    Individual pension plans
    Sponsored gym membership
    Work-life balance with regular working hours

To ensure a smooth onboarding process, onsite presence is required. Once onboarded, hybrid work options are available.

To Apply

Does this sound interesting? Submit your application in English or Swedish using the form below. Make sure to include:

    Cover letter
    CV
    University diploma with grades

Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.

For more information, contact Mikael Sterner at tel. 08-412 95 00.

We review applications continuously.

title: Staff Scientist in Atmospheric Optical Remote Sensing
description:
OChalmers University of Technology strives for academic excellence while addressing the challenges and needs of society and industry. We offer a creative and dynamic environment for research, education, innovation, and applied science. We are now looking for a Staff Scientist to join our team and help strengthen our ongoing research.

About the role

As a Staff Scientist, you will become part of a professional research environment where your specialist competence contributes to the quality and continuity of ongoing scientific work. In this role, you are expected to support research activities with your expertise and to work closely with colleagues and research leaders to help maintain and support the development of the research environment.

The position focuses on the operation, development, and scientific exploitation of atmospheric remote-sensing research infrastructures within the division, with a central focus on the long-term operation of the high-resolution solar FTIR stations at Harestua (Norway) and Onsala (Sweden). Another aspect of the position is also to contribute to the continuity and further development of the research infrastructure, including the division's research computing environment and collaboration with national and international partners.

About the division and department

https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/env/ consists of five research divisions, with the common goal of providing excellent research that can enable solutions for transition to a sustainable society. The department offers a dynamic and inspiring academic environment, and well-developed networks with industry and relevant public stakeholders at national, international and global levels.





https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/env/research/geo/ conducts research, education, and utilization within a wide range of scientific and engineering disciplines, including ground-based, airborne and satellite measurements, as well as numerical modeling and data analysis of various climate parameters. The division operates ground-based atmospheric observation infrastructures, including the high-resolution solar FTIR stations at Harestua (Norway) and the Onsala Space Observatory (Sweden), which provide long-term atmospheric composition measurements to the Network for the Detection of Atmospheric Composition Change (NDACC) and Total Carbon Column Observing network (TCCON). The Onsala station is also part of the European Research infrastructure ACTRIS.



Your responsibilities

As a Staff Scientist, you are part of a research group where you will provide advanced scientific, technical, and methodological support to strengthen research activities. Key responsibilities include:

    Supporting research groups with expert knowledge in methods, techniques, and instruments
    Developing and implementing scientific methods and instrumentation
    Contributing to research infrastructures through technical and methodological service
    Operate, maintain and further develop the high-resolution solar FTIR stations at Harestua and Onsala, and associated measurement systems
    Perform quality assurance and control of the instruments, including troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and replacement and adjustment of components (e.g., laser replacement and alignment)
    Process and analyze solar FTIR spectra using the SFIT4 retrieval software
    Prepare, quality-control and archive NDACC data products
    Develop and maintain data-analysis and processing workflows
    Manage the division's Linux-based computer servers and user accounts
    Contribute to the development and maintenance of international research collaborations
    Contribute to research publication and reporting
    Contribute to training and teaching in the use of methods and instruments

Qualifications and merits

To qualify for this position, you should have:

    A doctoral degree in atmospheric science, physics, or a related field
    Advanced experience with high-resolution solar FTIR spectroscopy and ground-based atmospheric remote-sensing instrumentation. Including the operation (measuring solar spectra) and maintenance of solar FTIR system
    Proven experience with atmospheric retrieval software, such as SFIT4
    Programming skills in Python or other relevant languages
    Experience in computer management and support of Linux-based servers
    Proficiency in written and spoken English (Swedish language courses are offered.)

The following qualifications are considered meritorious:

    Experience with Bruker 125HR and Bruker 125M instruments. Meritorious skills include Instrumental line shape cell measurements and retrievals (Linefit software), laser replacement and alignment, experience with Norhof liquid nitrogen system, dual-acquisition measurements
    Experience with DOAS or MAX-DOAS techniques
    Experience with atmospheric chemistry-transport models and/or reanalysis datasets to support data analyses
    Experience of active collaboration within NDACC or comparable international atmospheric remote-sensing networks
    Experience from writing research applications
    Peer‑reviewed publications in leading journals

Employment

This is a full-time permanent position.

What we offer





Chalmers provides a dynamic and inspiring environment in the coastal city of https://www.goteborg.com/en, combining academic excellence with a strong commitment to sustainability, equality, and collaboration.





Read more about https://www.chalmers.se/en/about-chalmers/work-with-us/ and our https://www.chalmers.se/en/about-chalmers/work-with-us/chalmers-as-an-employer/benefits-and-conditions/. Learn more about life in Gothenburg and Sweden’s family-friendly policies, including generous parental leave, subsidized childcare, free education, and universal healthcare, at https://www.movetogothenburg.com/.





Chalmers promotes gender balance and actively works with equality and inclusion initiatives, such as https://www.chalmers.se/en/about-chalmers/organisation-and-governance/equality/genie-gender-initiative-for-excellence/.







Application



Please read more and apply at www.chalmers.se





Application deadline: October 20, 2026









Contact







For questions about the position, please contact:

Johan Mellqvist, Full professor in Optical Remote Sensing



e-mail: mailto:johan.mellqvist@chalmers.se



Phone: +46317724855





Lars Ulander, Head of Division



e-mail: mailto:lars.ulander@chalmers.se

description:

title: Space Test Engineer
description:
About the role:

As a Space Test Engineer at APR Technologies you will specify, plan and execute functional, performance, and environmental test campaigns throughout the product development lifecycle. You ensure that products meet system requirements and qualification standards, collaborating closely with project teams, external test laboratories and suppliers.

Key responsibilities:

    

Specify, plan, execute, and document functional, performance, and environmental test campaigns throughout the product development lifecycle.

    

Develop test procedures, test setups, and instrumentation plans based on system requirements.

    

Provide input during the design phase to ensure that the design is verifiable.

    

Operate thermal and environmental test equipment, including thermal chambers, environmental chambers, chillers, heaters, and thermal-vacuum facilities.

    

Ensure accurate data collection, calibration, and analysis of test results while maintaining traceability between requirements and verification activities.

    

Support verification planning, FMEA, and risk assessments.

    

Identify and resolve issues during testing and system integration.

    

Produce high-quality test documentation, including procedures, test reports, and verification control documents.

    

Work with thermal engineers in correlating test results with thermal models.

    

Collaborate closely with project teams, external test laboratories, and suppliers to plan, execute, and validate test activities.

Who you are:

You are structured and analytical, working from requirements to results with care. You are comfortable in a fast-moving, technical environment where priorities can shift and decisions get made quickly. You work well with others, share your knowledge and take ownership of your results so that others can rely on them.

What you bring:

    

Engineering degree or equivalent.

    

Hardware testing experience.

    

Knowledge of test methods, instrumentation, and data analysis.

    

Fluency in English.

    

Ability to write clear protocols and reports

    

Strong collaboration and communication skills.

    

Problem-solving mindset.

An extra plus if you have:

    

Testing experience from space projects.

    

Familiarity with relevant ECSS standards.

    

Experience with test automation, preferably using Python.

    

Experience with fluid systems, thermal systems or other pressurized systems.

Working at APR Technologies:

APR operates at the intersection of physics, engineering and one of the most pressing problems in technology: thermal management. The ambition is to become the global industry standard for thermal control, and we are well on our way.

Here your work is visible, your perspective counts and what you do has a real impact on where the company goes. Working here means solving problems that have real consequences for how technology develops and how much energy it consumes. It means being part of a team that takes both the technology and the business seriously.

About APR Technologies:

APR Technologies is a Swedish deep tech company developing and producing high-performance liquid cooling for applications in space, defense, batteries and chip cooling. Our core technology Rheion®, developed in collaboration with ESA and Airbus and protected by more than 70 granted patents in 22 countries, directs cooling liquid flow directly to the heat source with no moving parts.

title: Senior IT Technician - Group Infrastructure

title: Staff Scientist
description:
Chalmers University of Technology strives for academic excellence while addressing the challenges and needs of society and industry. We offer a creative and dynamic environment for research, education, innovation, and applied science. We are now looking for a Staff Scientist to join our team and help strengthen our ongoing research.

About the role

As a Staff Scientist, you will become part of a professional research environment where your specialist competence contributes to the quality and continuity of ongoing and planned scientific work. You will support research activities with your expertise and work closely with colleagues and research leaders.

We are looking for a Staff Scientist with specialist knowledge in Urban Morphology, Urban Analytics and Social-Ecological Sensing. You will provide scientific and methodological support in spatial modelling, the integration and analysis of spatial, longitudinal and sensor-based datasets, and empirical studies using field-based sensor technologies. A key part of the role is to contribute to the development and maintenance of a shared research infrastructure supporting projects across the research group.

About us

You will join the https://www.chalmers.se/institutioner/ace/forskning/spatial-morphology/, an internationally oriented research group investigating how urban form influences urban life through spatial analysis and empirically validated models. The group brings together expertise in urban morphology, Space Syntax, GIS, urban analytics, pedestrian modelling and Social-Ecological Urbanism. Current research extends this approach to ecological conditions, environmental exposure, health and wellbeing.

You will work in an interdisciplinary research environment connecting urban planning and design with environmental and health research. We value collaboration, intellectual openness and an inclusive research environment.

Your responsibilities

As a Staff Scientist, you will provide advanced scientific, technical and methodological support to strengthen the group's research activities. Your responsibilities include:

    Develop, implement and maintain methods, datasets and spatial models for the quantitative analysis of the built and natural environment.
    Develop and maintain workflows for integrating, processing and analysing large spatial, longitudinal and sensor-based datasets.
    Develop and implement methods for social-ecological sensing, including field-based collection and processing of data on ecological conditions, environmental exposures, human activity and health.
    Integrate sensor observations with spatial models to support empirical validation, model development and longitudinal monitoring.
    Contribute specialist methodological expertise across the research group and collaborate with researchers in urban ecology, biodiversity, environmental health and related fields.
    Provide scientific and methodological support to PhD candidates and postdoctoral researchers in collaboration with the group's research leaders. This may also include co-supervision of PhD candidates, with a focus on specialist support.
    Contribute specialist expertise to joint scientific publications and the communication of research findings.
    Contribute to external research proposals and collaborations that strengthen the group's established and planned research activities.

Qualifications and merits

To qualify for this position, you should have:

    A doctoral degree in Urban Planning, Urban Design, Architecture, Urban Studies, Geography or another closely related field, with a research profile relevant to quantitative urban morphology and/or social-ecological urban research.
    Strong expertise in the quantitative analysis of urban form and spatial structure, including experience with GIS and spatial modelling.
    Advanced experience in geospatial data processing, analysis and visualisation, including the integration of data from multiple spatial and temporal sources.
    Experience developing and applying quantitative methods and reproducible analytical workflows, including programming in Python, R or similar.

title: Software Developer
description:
Hej Software Developer!  

Inter IKEA Group connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and ensures alignment of the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone.

This role is positioned in Retail Concept Operations, Digital Engineering and Technology Platform Management. You will belong to the Commercial Intelligence team, reporting to the Technology Manager.

Digital Engineering and Technology Platform Management is where we build, run and continuously improve the digital products and platforms that power the IKEA franchise offer. We bring together software engineering, platform engineering and quality engineering competence to create optimal preconditions for the business and people who design, develop and manage IKEA's offer across a connected and optimised value chain — all to deliver growth and enable low cost. We are fully integrated into the development process, providing competence, tools, solutions, processes and ways of working across many different areas. We work in cross-functional, agile teams that value ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement, and we're never done exploring better tools, technologies and practices to build a stronger digital foundation for IKEA's digital products and business.

Our team is based in Malmö, Sweden.



About the role

As a Software Developer, you’ll play an important part in the team and bring valuable IKEA knowledge into a new setting. In the coming years, we will continue to build the digital backbone that connects our range, our data and our customer experience — and semantic technologies are at the heart of how we make that connection meaningful. Your primary focus will be continuing to grow our knowledge graph and data-driven capabilities. We hope that you are curious about ontologies, data modelling and building software that helps machines and people understand IKEA's world a little better.  

This is an entry-level software engineering role, assigned to a technology domain or digital product. You'll work on one or several product components — spanning front-end, back-end, mobile, data modelling, data ingestion pipelines, or embedded systems depending on your area.  

You'll be part of a team that values quality, reuse, and learning from each other. You'll plan your own work, keep the backlog up to date, and contribute both to day-to-day delivery and to continuously improving how the team works. The impact of our work continues to resonate in homes and hearts across the world.  

On a typical working day, you will:

    Develop and maintain software solutions within your assigned technology domain, platform, or product area.
    Deliver tested, maintainable, and deployable code that supports business outcomes while adhering to architectural principles, security requirements, and engineering best practices.
    Collaborate closely with your product team to create robust, scalable, and cohesive solutions, always prioritizing the overall product experience.
    Plan and organize development work effectively by breaking down complex tasks, prioritizing high-impact activities, and maintaining an up-to-date backlog.
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering standards, ways of working, and development practices while staying curious about emerging technologies and innovations.
    Support delivery planning and performance tracking through activities such as feature estimation, backlog refinement, and monitoring team throughput.
    Maintain clear and accurate technical documentation and actively share knowledge, expertise, and learnings with teammates.
    Contribute to solution ideation and design by developing proposals, prototypes, mock-ups, data models, and configurations that help shape future product capabilities.



What we’d like you to bring to the table

The role as a Software Developer requires you to:

    Have solid IKEA experience
    Have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
    Have up to three years of experience in software development, making this an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals looking to grow their expertise.
    Demonstrate a solid understanding of software engineering principles and hands-on experience developing high-quality software solutions.
    Have experience working with agile development practices, continuous integration, and automated deployment tools.
    Possess technical knowledge within software development, with an interest in or exposure to semantic technologies.
    Bring a collaborative and solution-oriented mindset, combined with a strong curiosity for learning and continuous improvement.
    Communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to a variety of stakeholders.
    Be comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership, and approaching complex challenges with a pragmatic mindset.

It is a plus if you also:

    Have experience working with semantic technologies such as Metaphactory, RDFox, or similar platforms.
    Have experience independently evaluating, testing, and prototyping new technologies or technical solutions.
    Are familiar with the IKEA culture, values, and ways of working.



We welcome your application  

This role is published as part of an internal recruitment process connected to our organisational changes. It offers an opportunity for co-workers whose experience and competence may be relevant.  

We look forward to receiving your application by 2nd of October at the latest. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we might start interviewing early for certain roles. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, or if you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, feel free to contact the Recruiter Vera Bendz (vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com).

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in Inter IKEA Systems BV, Inter IKEA Systems Services AB and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

title: Structural Analysis Engineer
description:
Would you like to work with structural analysis that directly impacts the design and performance of industrial equipment?

Valmet is looking for a Structural Analysis Engineer to work with process machinery, pressure vessels and other industrial equipment.

The role combines analytical and code-based design calculations with finite element analysis in ANSYS. Working with design engineers, you will assess structural integrity and provide calculations and recommendations for product development and design verification. As part of the team, you will support various business units across Valmet with structural analysis expertise. If you enjoy combining analytical thinking with practical engineering impact, this could be the next step in your career.

This position can be based at any of our main Swedish sites: Gothenburg, Karlstad, or Sundsvall.

Your responsibilities

    Perform static, dynamic, fatigue and fracture mechanics analyses using ANSYS.
    Develop and validate FE models for our machines and other equipment, evaluate the results and document conclusions and recommendations.
    Work with design engineers to dimension and improve components and structures, considering strength, manufacturability, reliability and cost.
    Carry out analytical and code-based design calculations for pressure vessels and other structures in accordance with applicable standards. Check FE results using analytical methods and participate in design reviews.
    Support material selection, improve analysis methods and investigate structural problems and their causes.
    When needed, perform measurements and field studies on our machines and equipment to support R&D or failure analysis and resolve technical problems.

Expectations for you

    You hold a Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline.
    You have at least three years of industrial experience in structural analysis, ideally involving heavy machinery, pulp and paper or energy applications. Experience with pressure vessels and code-based design calculations is an advantage.
    You are proficient in a major FEA platform, such as ANSYS, Abaqus or Nastran, and have a strong foundation in solid mechanics, materials science and structural dynamics. Experience with ANSYS is an advantage.
    You explain technical results clearly and work well with other engineers. Experience with CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Inventor or Creo is an advantage.
    You have good spoken and written Swedish for day-to-day collaboration. You also have good spoken and written English for technical documentation and international contacts.

We offer

At Valmet, you will have the opportunity to work in a collaborative and international environment where engineering expertise drives innovation and customer value. We support your professional development through continuous learning opportunities, modern work tools, and meaningful work that contributes to sustainable industrial solutions. We value our people and strive to create a workplace where everyone can grow, contribute, and succeed.

Want to know more?

Did we catch your interest? Please submit your application through the link provided no later than November 1, 2026. We review applications continuously.  For additional information, please contact Tomas Vikström, Senior Manager, Technology competences at tomas.vikstrom@valmet.com.

We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. 

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.

Join the team – and lead the way with us!

title: Research Assistant in Animal Science
description:
Department of Animal Biosciences

Re-winding the clock – using transgenics to re-wild the chicken

We are looking for an engaged and enthusiastic research assistant to join our team looking at the genetic basis of feralization and domestication in the chicken. For this position we  are looking for a candidate with experience of working with chickens, breeding them, collecting physiological and behavioural samples and phenotypes, as well as dissection. Laboratory skills, including DNA and RNA extraction, PCR, qPCR and the like will be performed, and any experience of these is a benefit. Knowledge of cell work (cell culture and maintenance, etc) is beneficial, as is some experience of lab management (ordering materials, equipment maintenance, etc).

About the position

The project itself has recently been funded by Revive & Restore, a US charity, to assist with a project working on de-extincting the passenger pigeon. The role of the project that will be worked on is to use transgenic technology to turn a domestic chicken into a wild/ feral one. This involves incorporating genomic regions identified using datasets of feral chickens, and also datasets taken from a wild x domestic chicken intercross in combination with single cell technology. The successful candidate will be assisting with the care and maintenance of the chickens involved, as well as performing the phenotyping assays (including behavioural and physiological measures), and also assisting in the gene editing injections. In addition, some basic lab work will be performed, including DNA extraction and similar types of work, also including some basic cell maintenance. As such, a wide variety of duties will be performed and the candidate will be actively involved with all other group members in the lab and their projects.

Your profile

You must hold a degree in biology, natural sciences, animal sciences, engineering, or equivalent. You must also have a documented proficiency in written and spoken English.

The candidate must have experience of working with chickens or other avian species. This work should include behavioural and physiological testing, as well as animal handling. Laboratory skills are a benefit to the position.

The appointment will be offered to the applicant who, following a qualitative comprehensive assessment, is deemed to have the best skill set to conduct and develop the duties in question and contribute to the positive development of the organisation.

About us

The department is part of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Science and is responsible for education and research in several basic and applied areas. These areas include anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, pharmacology, toxicology, genetics, breeding, immunology, bacteriology, virology, parasitology, epizootology, comparative medicine, food safety, bioinformatics and One Health. Our research covers everything from production animals to sports and pet animals, laboratory animals and wild animals. The department's researchers work on the entire scale from molecular mechanisms and microbiology to the structure, function and behaviour of animals, and how these are affected by breeding, physical activity, care, production, stress, environmental factors and diseases.

For more information about the department or division, visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/Animal-Biosciences/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

title: Develop your radiology career in Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Radiologists career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden currently has a strong need for specialist radiologists within both general diagnostic radiology and several subspecialties. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, radiologists from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within the Swedish healthcare system.

We collaborate with hospitals and imaging departments across Sweden, ranging from regional hospitals to large university hospitals.

Our goal is to match your professional background, experience and preferences with the right workplace.

Radiologists in Sweden play a central role in clinical decision-making and work in close collaboration with physicians from many specialties. The work is primarily clinically focused and supported by modern imaging technology, digital reporting systems and well-structured workflows. Departments typically operate advanced diagnostic equipment including MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional radiography, supported by modern PACS systems.

Professional Development

The current need in Sweden is primarily for radiologists who wish to focus on clinical diagnostic work. Radiologists often work broadly within diagnostic radiology while gradually developing subspecialist expertise depending on their interests and the needs of the department. Multidisciplinary collaboration with clinicians is an important part of everyday work.

For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.

You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.

Support for your family

Many physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.

Language training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.

Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.

Requirements

We are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.

Interested?

title: Manager - IT Network, Lund
description:
Do you want to lead a team that keeps a global company connected? We're looking for a Manager - IT Network to lead our IT Network team and take ownership of the network that ties Axis together worldwide. The role is based at our headquarters in Lund!

Your future team
The IT Network team is part of our IT Infrastructure & Operations department and consists of around 10 senior technical specialists. You and your team are responsible for the strategic development of the Axis network. Together, you will shape the future of our network through clear roadmaps and action plans, based on an understanding of Axis' requirements and of how technology is developing in the network market.

You will report to the Director of IT Infrastructure.

What you'll do here as Manager - IT Network
Every meeting, every product shipped, every colleague logging in from an Axis site somewhere in the world depends on the network working, not only today but in the future. As Manager - IT Network, you lead the team that defines the future network agenda and makes sure the development plans are carried out.

    Lead, coach and develop the IT Network team, with responsibility for the team's development and your colleagues' personal development
    Own our global network infrastructure from a strategic and tactical point of view, ensuring stable and reliable day-to-day operation of the network
    Set the direction for the network area and drive architecture decisions together with colleagues across IT and stakeholders globally within Axis
    Manage vendors, service providers and contracts
    Take ownership of the budget and forecast for the network area
    Work closely with information security to keep our network secure

Who are you?
You enjoy leading through others. Coaching, giving feedback and helping people grow is what makes the job meaningful to you, and you see the power in a team where different perspectives meet.

You're structured, you know when to zoom out and when to go into the details, and you communicate clearly with colleagues wherever they sit in the world.

You are comfortable in technical discussions and understand what they mean from a business perspective. Leading change in a complex infrastructure environment should be something you feel excited about.

You should be open and curious towards people and technology and have the courage to challenge the status quo.

We'd love to hear that you have:

    A degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent experience
    Solid experience of global networks
    Solid experience of leading change, both technical and organizational
    Experience of developing people and teams
    Professional working proficiency in English and Swedish, spoken and written

Bonus points if you also have:

    Experience of working in a global environment

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.

Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:

Axis Career Hub

Life at Axis blog  

Engineering at Axis blog

Innovation at Axis

Ready to Act?

title: Systems Architect to Mycronic PCB Assembly Solutions
description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of advanced products? Then you might be the person we’re looking for!

About the role

Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories.

We Offer

    A strategic role where you will have a significant influence on the direction of our world-leading Jet Printing product.
    The opportunity to work with new technology and contribute to innovation together with our Jet Printing core development team of 15 specialists across software, mechanics, electronics, configuration management, testing, product management, as well as collaborate with a wide range of functions across the company.
    A culture of innovation and collaboration, working together at our Kista office.



Work tasks

As a Systems Architect, you will lead the definition, development, and evolution of robust, scalable, and sustainable system architectures. You will provide the architectural perspective that connects our engineering disciplines and helps translate business and customer needs into technical direction. To do this effectively, you will invest the necessary time to truly understand our products and customers. This includes gaining firsthand experience of their perspective by using our systems during experiments, exploring new opportunities, and developing a deep understanding of how our solutions are used in practice.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Lead and align cross-functional technical development, ensuring that software, electronics, mechanics, and mechatronics work together as an integrated system.
    Explore and drive the use of AI to deepen our understanding of the product, identify new opportunities, and improve how we develop and evolve our solutions.
    Lead workshops and facilitate discussions around business and technical needs. Balance the overall architectural perspective with the necessary technical details while engaging others in developing concepts that meet customer and product requirements.
    Support sales at customer-specific development by performing requirement analyses and product definition.
    Establish, develop and share knowledge of current and future manufacturing technologies.

We are looking for

You are a true team player with an open and positive mindset, a strong sense of responsibility, and the ability to thrive in a global, fast-changing environment. You bring a pragmatic approach to product development, knowing when to push for improvements and when to recognize what already works well. You communicate clearly and effectively with people across different roles and areas of expertise, and take a thoughtful, structured approach to moving work forward, understanding what needs to be done, which competencies are needed, and when to involve the right people.

Furthermore, you have:

    A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Electronics, Mechatronics or similar.
    Solid experience in systems architecture for complex products combining hardware and software.
    Solid knowledge of systems engineering, both theoretical and practical.
    Experience translating stakeholder requirements into technical solutions.
    Strong ability to lead technical discussions and drive decisions.
    Experience leading technical projects or product development activities.
    Strong communication skills in English.

It will be considered a merit if you have:

    Knowledge of Swedish.
    Proven experience in exploring and driving the use of AI in product development.

Other information

    Start: By agreement
    Location: Stockholm, Kista
    Employment: Permanent, Full-time.
    Contact information: Senior Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se. Recruitment Coordinator Vera Mohlin, vera.mohlin@academicwork.se.
    This recruitment process is managed by Academic Work. Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the position are directed to Academic Work.
    Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

Our recruitment process

    Problem solving- and personality test
    Phone interview with Academic Work
    In-depth interview with Academic Work
    Interviews with Mycronic
    Reference checking & decision

title: Senior Security Engineer - Network Security
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

Join our Cyber Security Engineering unit, where innovation and security drive us. We are transforming technology with modern Network Security, integrations and cloud services. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Network Security Engineering team. This role involves architecting, designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security measures to protect our global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on expertise. This role requires a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, Network Security technologies, and the ability to collaborate across multiple globally dispersed stakeholders and teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

    Lead the development, optimization and integration of network security policies, rules and monitoring across platforms such as NDR, SSE, SD‑WAN and proxy solutions
    Design and improve network security solutions across branches, stores and data centers, ensuring strong alignment with business and security needs
    Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments and threat modelling, and drive hardening initiatives across our network landscape
    Modernize network security by transitioning from legacy systems to modern SSE and ZTNA solutions, supported by clear roadmaps, policies and plans
    Monitor and enhance the performance, availability and reliability of network security solutions, ensuring compliance with ISO, NIST, GDPR and internal standards
    Design, configure and troubleshoot network security devices and services across on‑prem and cloud environments, providing advanced Level‑3 support when needed

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You’ll join a friendly and collaborative Network Security Engineering team of seven, soon to be eight, working closely with colleagues across Business Tech. Your daily partners will include network SMEs, Cyber Security Advisors, Core Platforms and Global Infrastructure Services, as well as teams supporting stores, warehouses and new market entries. You’ll also connect with external partners and contribute to cross‑functional projects where network and cyber security come together. This is a highly collaborative environment where your expertise will help shape our security posture and uplift the team’s cyber maturity.

WHO YOU ARE

    6+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, with a focus on network environments
    Strong, practical knowledge of: Network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, SWG, SASE, VPN, CASB, ZTNA), Cloud platforms: Azure, GCP, Security architecture methodologies and governance frameworks
    Expertise in network security solutions and products provided by Cisco, HP Aruba, Zscaler and Citrix NetScaler (proven by certificates)
    Strong knowledge of risk assessment and security control frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST).
    Familiarity with security maturity models including C2M2
    Excellent ability to translate security requirements into implementable engineering solutions.
    Strong understanding of IP networking and protocols, including IPsec, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, and QoS.
    Understand regulatory and compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS, Schrems, etc.).
    Independent problem-solving, addressing complex security challenges with minimal supervision.

Preferred qualifications:

    CCNP (Security) or higher-level certifications such as the CCIE.
    CISSP or OSCP security certifications.
    Azure Security Engineer, or GCP Security Engineer certification.
    Experience with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira/Confluence)

WHO WE ARE

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

Benefits

    All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)
    All our employees receive a staff discount card, which is usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET.
    Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation and wellness allowance 4000 SEK/yearly
    Access to Benify, for discounts on e.g. Gym memberships, travel, hotels and many other great deals.
    Compensation boost during parental leave

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

You will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders, product teams, architecture, and engineering, helping identify, define, and prioritize high-value use cases that leverage connected data across customers, accounts, products, contracts, services, finance, assets, and customer interactions.

Strategic Planning & Prioritization

title: iOS Developer
description:
Reshape how millions of people buy and sell vehicles at FINN.no, Blocket.se and Vend’s other Nordic marketplace.

Tech stack? Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI, SPM, CombineCompany? Vend, home to Northern Europe's most iconic marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen. Our team consists of 8 skilled individuals who work agile and dynamically towards concrete goals. We collaborate closely with an extended product team. As a valued member of our team, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact, contribute with your unique expertise, and grow both personally and professionally.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

    Experienced iOS developer with at least 3 years of hands-on experience
    Fluent in English. Clear communication is key in our international, cross-functional team.
    Proactive and responsible, someone who steps up when needed and takes ownership of their work.
    Team player who loves to collaborate, share knowledge, and learn from others.
    Quality-focused, taking pride in writing clean code and testing thoroughly to ensure smooth user experiences.
    Product minded with a keen eye for great mobile UX. You enjoy sitting with product managers and designers during discovery to prototype and shape the end product.
    Outspoken, comfortable challenging ideas and contributing to open, honest discussions.

WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?Day-to-day work & projects cookingDay-to-day tasks involve experimenting, developing features to enhance user experience, and improving the quality and functionality of the overall product. We work on several areas of the transaction journey, and as a team member you’ll be a key collaborator with product UX by participating in the discovery process and help come up with the best solutions.Not everything is cotton candy clouds, so here’s the main opportunity to improveSometimes we run into obstacles and we might need to reprioritise, which is why it’s important that you as an individual are able to adapt to a fast paced environment, and provide input when you identify areas of the product that can be improved.On the other hand, this brings along a great opportunity to leave your fingerprint on how the product is drafted! Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.QUESTIONS?Engineering Manager Andre Martins is happy to answer any question you may have about the role, and can be reached at andre.martins@vend.com.

At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.
